title: SerializedAssetRef
description: Serialized reference to a loaded asset (e.g. a Texture). Names the request the asset was loaded with, never the asset data: the logical source the caller wrote - the one an asset variant rule was declared for, not the file one device happened to select - along with the options that identify the resource and any presentation options its type saves. The receiving loader chooses its own source variant. Preload assets whose node serializers use DeserializeContext.resolveAsset; version 3 Sprite texture references can instead load when attached to a scene. Version 3 writes the registered type ID beside the logical source. Older documents may contain a bare source string or an untagged options object.
